title: 第5章 别不识好歹
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
坐在竹排上，用柴刀片出了一些小竹条，扯了点事先准备的枯柴，摸出火折子在那扁平的大石头上生了一小堆火，将小竹条进行着烘烤，烤出汗青，直到烤的韧性足够了，又将小竹条截断成了小段。从怀里扯出了之前在村里准备的麻线，用手绷了绷，确认了结实程度应该足够，遂将小段竹条分节点绑在了麻线上，绑的位置在竹条中间点上。
又从怀里扯出一根麦秆，截成小小段，将韧性十足的小竹条卯弯，小段麦秆将绷在一起的小竹条两头给套住了，让小竹条无法弹开。手到破衣洞里一阵掏，摸出了一小把麦粒，这是他在村里泥地里一粒粒扒拉出来的，估计是匪兵抢粮时洒落的。捻一粒麦粒塞进了绷住小竹条两头的麦秆孔眼中，如此作为，在一根麻线上连做了十几个简易机关。
随后麻线入水，一头拴在了竹排上，剩下的就听天由命了，牛有道也不管了，一截竹筒从河里取了水，慢慢咽入口中捂热再咽下肚子，坐在竹排上烤着火，欣赏着河道两岸的风景，眼神中明显有着对这个世界的好奇。
也不知过了多久，突然感觉坐下竹排有点动静，似乎有什么东西在水下拽动，神色一喜。动静不断传来，他却坐那没动，没等多久动静就消停了。
竹排后面拉起麻线往回收，很快便见水中拖出了一只两三斤重的鱼。两边鱼鳃已经被弹开的竹条给撑开了，才一会儿工夫这条鱼就已经半死不活了。别小看这小小而又简单的捕鱼机关，鱼鳃乃是鱼在水下的呼吸系统，呼吸产生了障碍，就算是在水下生活的鱼也得被水给淹死。这竹条有弹性，鱼一下两下也挣不脱，加之缺氧在水下很快就没了力气，一旦中了就很难跑掉，鱼钩钓上的鱼反而能在水下较劲许久。
当然，这小机关也有缺陷，大鱼难搞到。
没办法，村里条件有限，没有食物给他携带，他只能因地制宜随便拾点东西凑合一下，一路上总得想办法果腹吧。
将鱼摘下一扔，又重新绷上小段麦秆装上诱饵再次放入水中。其他麦粒已经泡涨，他估摸着诱鱼几率已经大大增加。
捡起半死不活的鱼，摸出匕首将鱼开膛剥腹在河里稍作清洗，重新点上火，棒棒将鱼一串，就在那自得其乐地烤了起来。既然能抓到鱼，看来这边的生态环境还不错，他准备吃喝拉撒就在这竹排上了，听说这边兵荒马乱的，估计还是呆在竹排上安全点。
鱼刚烤熟，烫着双手吹嘘的牛有道还没啃上几口，竹排下面又有了拉扯的动静，牛有道乐了。
与此同时，远处岸上，一辆马车正在颠簸狂奔，后面一队人马疾驰追着。很快追上，两边冲过的骑兵扬起弓弩朝着马车内一阵乱射，惨叫声传出，马车也迅速被控停。
竹排经过时，慢慢啃着烤鱼的牛有道亲眼目睹士兵从马车内掀落几具尸体，有一人似乎没死，正跪地求饶，一将拍马靠近，手中枪一枪刺出，将跪地之人刺倒。
光天化日之下如此行凶，对经历过另一个世道的牛有道来说，有点过分，最重要的是之前村庄的见闻，令他对这群官兵先入为主，没什么好感，却也只能是冷眼旁观。
拔回枪的将领也注意到了牛有道，稀奇，竹排上烤鱼？
牛有道也发现这群官兵注意到了自己，遂假装良民，忙自己的，从竹排后面拽上麻线，又收了一条鱼上来。
那将领眼中露出饶有兴趣神色，对一旁手下道：“隆冬季节，破烂寒衣，却有办法果腹，这少年看着机灵，稍作训练也许是个好苗子。”说话是个女人声音。
下属会意，这是要将那少年抓来当兵，当即朝竹排上的牛有道呐喊：“那少年郎，快些靠岸，有话问你。”想骗过来。
牛有道哪敢靠岸，当做没听见，衣服上随便擦了下手，拔了插竹排上的烤鱼，继续埋头吃自己的，有装聋子的味道。
哚！一支箭羽钉在了竹排上颤微微，就在牛有道身边，差点吓牛有道一跳，这要是射偏一点还得了？
怒眼抬头看去，结果发现正是之前提枪杀人之将。

对方坐在马背，持弓指来，喊道：“少年郎，过来！”

content_en:
Sitting on the bamboo raft, I used a firewood blade to cut out some small bamboo strips, pulled some dry firewood that I had prepared in advance, took out the firewood sticks, and lit a small fire on the big flat stone. I baked the small bamboo strips until they were tough enough, and then cut the small bamboo strips into small segments. Pulled out the twine prepared in the village from his arms, stretched it with his hands, and confirmed that it should be strong enough. Then he tied the small bamboo strips to the twine at the middle point of the bamboo strips.
Then he pulled out a wheat straw from his arms, cut it into small sections, and bent the tough bamboo strips. The small sections of wheat straw caught the two ends of the stretched bamboo strips, making it impossible for the small bamboo strips to spring open. He dug into the hole in his tattered clothes and pulled out a handful of wheat grains. He had pulled them out one by one from the mud in the village. They were probably scattered by the bandits when they were robbing grain. Twist a grain of wheat and stuff it into the holes of the wheat straw that stretches the two ends of the small bamboo strip. In this way, more than a dozen simple mechanisms are made on a piece of twine.
Then the twine was put into the water, one end was tied to the bamboo raft, and the rest was left to fate. Niu Youdao didn't care. He took a piece of bamboo tube and took water from the river. He slowly swallowed it to warm his mouth and then swallowed it. He sat on the bamboo raft and warmed himself by the fire, admiring the scenery on both sides of the river. There was obvious curiosity about the world in his eyes.
I don’t know how long it took, but suddenly I felt some movement on the bamboo raft I was sitting on, as if something was pulling under the water, and I looked happy. There was constant noise, but he sat there without moving. It didn't take long for the noise to stop.
I pulled up the twine from behind the bamboo raft to retrieve it, and soon I saw a fish weighing two or three kilograms pulled out of the water. The gills on both sides of the fish had been stretched open by the bamboo strips that popped open, and within a short time the fish was already half dead. Don't underestimate this small and simple fishing mechanism. Fish gills are the respiratory system of fish underwater. If breathing is obstructed, even fish living underwater will be drowned by water. The bamboo strips are elastic, and the fish cannot break free even if it takes one or two bites. In addition, due to lack of oxygen, it quickly loses its strength underwater. Once it is hit, it is difficult to escape. The fish caught on the hook can compete underwater for a long time.
Of course, this small mechanism also has shortcomings, and it is difficult to get big fish.
There was no other way. The conditions in the village were limited and there was no food for him to carry. He could only make do by picking up some things according to local conditions. He had to find a way to satisfy his hunger along the way.
Pick off the fish and throw it away, then put a small piece of wheat straw on it and put it into the water again. The other wheat grains had soaked up, and he estimated that the chance of attracting fish had greatly increased.
He picked up the half-dead fish, took out his dagger, gutted the fish, washed it in the river for a while, lit the fire again, skewered the fish with sticks, and grilled it to his own content. Since he can catch fish, it seems that the ecological environment here is not bad. He plans to eat, drink and have sex on the bamboo raft. He heard that there is a war here, so it is probably safer to stay on the bamboo raft.
The fish had just been grilled, and Niu Youdao, who was scalding his hands and boasting, had not even taken a few bites when there was another pulling sound under the bamboo raft, and Niu Youdao was very happy.
At the same time, on the distant shore, a carriage was jolting and running wildly, followed by a group of people galloping in pursuit. Quickly catching up, the cavalry rushing past on both sides raised their crossbows and fired randomly into the carriage. Screams were heard, and the carriage was quickly stopped.
As the bamboo raft passed by, Niu Youdao, who was slowly munching grilled fish, witnessed the soldiers tearing down several corpses from the carriage. One man seemed to be alive and was kneeling down to beg for mercy. As soon as he approached the horse, he stabbed out his gun and stabbed the kneeling man down.
Carrying out such a murder in broad daylight was a bit too much for Niu Youdao, who had experienced another world. The most important thing was that what he had seen in the village before made him have a preconceived idea of ​​this group of officers and soldiers and had no favorable impression, but he could only watch with cold eyes.
The general who pulled back his gun also noticed Niu Youdao, and was surprised, grilled fish on bamboo rafts?
Niu Youdao also noticed that the group of officers and soldiers had noticed him, so he pretended to be a good citizen and went about his own business, dragging him up from behind the bamboo raft.Twine, another fish came up.
The general had a look of interest in his eyes and said to his subordinates: "In the middle of winter, he wears tattered cold clothes, but he has a way to make ends meet. This young man looks smart. With a little training, he might be a good prospect." The voice was a woman's.
The subordinate understood that they wanted to capture the young man as a soldier, and immediately shouted to Niu Youdao on the bamboo raft: "Young man, please come to the shore quickly. I have something to ask you." He wanted to deceive him.
Niu Youdao didn't dare to go to the shore. He pretended not to hear, wiped his hands casually on his clothes, picked up the grilled fish on the bamboo raft, and continued to eat his own food, which seemed like he was pretending to be deaf.
Do! An arrow fletched on the bamboo raft and trembled slightly, right next to Niu Youdao, almost frightening Niu Youdao. What if the shot missed slightly?
Angry eyes looked up, only to find that it was the general who had shot and killed him earlier.
The opponent sat on horseback, came with a bow and pointed his finger, and shouted: "Young man, come here!"
